method: Six-feature regularized logistic regression: overall Elo, surface Elo, last-10 form, overall head-to-head, same-surface head-to-head, and the latest five available head-to-head meetings. Meetings are recency-weighted with a neutral prior. Evaluation delays results by 21 days to protect against uncertain source timestamps. Live inference refreshes published completed results without that delay. Coefficients are fixed between training runs.
